source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + GPUBB image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- GPUBB upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided GPUBB image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the GPUBB flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the GPUBB version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the GPUBB version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: GPUBB firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade GPUBB firmware through the BMC WebUI while the host is off, perform the required AC cycle, and prove active backplane firmware plus complete GPU re-enumeration and health.
original_method: An engineer selects/commits each GPUBB image in WebUI, observes completion, performs the approved AC cycle and verifies GPUBB version, GPU topology/driver health, BMC access, host boot and logs.
manual_activity: The engineer performs and observes the WebUI flash core and controls any physical power hand-off in the approved AC-cycle method.
required_inputs: GPUBB board/GPU platform and signed transition images
Vendor WebUI and AC activation procedure
Expected GPU topology, driver/diagnostic/XID and GPUBB inventory
Known-good recovery and independent console/OOB path
safety_requirements: Verify package compatibility with exact GPUBB and GPU topology; do not infer from name alone.
Preserve the distinction between initial host-off and post-flash AC activation.
Use the approved AC mechanism; this row does not mandate physical cable removal.
Never retry, reverse or repeat AC after uncertainty; preserve GPU XID/kernel, BMC/SEL, WebUI and power evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare image/platform evidence, baseline GPU UUID/topology/driver/health, monitor approved power telemetry and collect post-AC GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host evidence.
Do not operate or claim the WebUI core and do not issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform WebUI transitions and AC-cycle hand-off.
Assess GPUBB activation, GPU enumeration/diagnostics and platform recovery, then issue verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Host-off, GPUBB and AC requirements fit, but browser driving does not replace manual acceptance and clean-single-reset is not in source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor WebUI manually and approved AC controller; use the named GPU check script only after validating its platform/GPU coverage and add GPUBB inventory readback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Host-off, GPUBB WebUI, AC cycle, named GPU script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED GPUBB UPDATE WITH GPU-TOPOLOGY AC VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the signed package to the exact GPUBB/GPU platform, capture WebUI terminal state, execute one controlled AC activation, then compare GPU UUID/topology, driver/diagnostic/XID/kernel evidence and active GPUBB inventory with baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: GPU baseboards supported by the vendor BMC WebUI and AC activation workflow.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record GPUBB image/board, GPU SKU/VBIOS/driver, BMC/WebUI/browser, diagnostic-script and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor GPUBB/GPU update, AC activation, diagnostic and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable GPU topology, XID/kernel evidence, explicit GPUBB inventory and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing/degraded GPUs after GPUBB activation rather than accepting only firmware version or browser completion.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved GPUBB/GPU transition and AC plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU enumeration can change ordering; correlate by UUID/topology rather than assumed indices.

project_override_considerations: Projects may set package, GPU diagnostic set and AC timing/mechanism. Completion is limited to the named GPUBB/GPU topology and approved plan.
expected_evidence: Approved GPUBB/GPU compatibility and image hashes
Manual WebUI progress and terminal status
Post-AC active GPUBB version and matched GPU topology/diagnostics plus BMC/host health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently targets GPUBB through WebUI with host off and required AC cycle. Images, GPU criteria and power details are project inputs; historical reset wording is not retained.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target and lifecycle are clear. Missing project artifacts do not create permanent BLOCKED; WebUI core makes the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps GPUBB/AC scope and rejects browser substitution/reset invention.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains GPU and recovery safeguards while changing BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds UUID/topology-based GPU evidence and case-specific AC handling.

review_improvement: Ties GPUBB firmware success to stable GPU topology and diagnostics after AC activation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A GPUBB update can leave the version readable while GPU links fail. The attended WebUI operation is manual core work, but surrounding GPU and power evidence can be automated under the project plan.
